She gestures with her right hand while speaking. (2) She lifts the large chili plush to show its size, holding it with both arms. She hugs the plush toy closely, smiling broadly with her eyes squinted, demonstrating how comfortable it is. Small chili emojis appear on the screen. (3) She continues to hold and squeeze the plush, highlighting its softness and the volume of the cotton inside. The camera stays at a medium shot, focusing on her upper body and the toy. (4) She points to the smug facial expression on the chili plush, which features black sunglasses and a small yellow smirk. She gestures with her hands to emphasize the design details. (5) The video ends with her sitting back on the couch, holding the plush, and inviting viewers to visit the store, maintaining a friendly and energetic facial expression.
